{{translated title}} The '''Ghost Masters''' (Japanese: '''ゴーストマスター''' ''Ghost Master'') are nine statue-based opponents found in the [[Sealed Fort]], which is located on [[GR Island]] in [[Pokémon Trading Card Game 2: The Invasion of Team GR!]]. All Ghost Masters fight a full duel with 6 prize cards. Defeating any of the Ghost Masters gets the player a Present Pack, which can have any of the cards from the game that can normally be found in packs.
